messages:
Maya (PM): quick heads-up 1 — ACME asked to bundle Dedicated + Priority lane into a single contract line and wants a temporary exemption from the Surge Softcap for launch (90d). Need impact triage + launch criteria.

Elena (Sales): short context: pilot for new product launch. they want predictable p95 latency and a contractual promise they won't be throttled for spikes during first 3 months.

Jon (Eng): technically doable. we can mark their traffic with a priority flag and route to their dedicated pool. work items: entitlement check + per-contract burst-window config. estimate: small infra changes, ~2 sprints to harden alerts.

Priya (Finance): removing softcap has cost implications. need a modeling number: what's the expected uplift if we allow 1.5x vs 2x headroom?

Jon (Eng): 2x is more conservative but more expensive. if customer prefers 1.5x, routing + quota metadata is identical; only allowance changes.

Sam (Legal): we can do a time-limited exemption but must have firm guardrails. propose clause stub: "During the Pilot Period (90 days), Customer may exceed Surge Softcap up to a defined allowance (e.g., 1.5x). Redwood retains the right to enforce throttling during infrastructure stress, security incidents, or abuse. Any sustained usage beyond allowance will be billed at Overage Rates and may be subject to remediation."

Elena (Sales): customer asks if we can cap the excess tokens so they don't unexpectedly pay huge overages. can we set both an uplift multiplier and a hard token cap?

Priya (Finance): yes, we can set a hard token ceiling per day. suggested: multiplier 1.5x and daily cap equal to 1.5 * committed daily throughput. I will run numbers for quoted overage risk.

Jon (Eng): operational checklist: 1) routing flag + contract-level burst allowance metadata, 2) daily usage telemetry feed, 3) alerting if allowance exceeded for 3 consecutive 5m windows, 4) automated throttle fallback. I can sketch the PR for the flag this sprint.

Maya (PM): proposed launch gating: - infra prototype routing + billing metadata in staging, - reporting surfaced to customer (daily), - finance signoff on modeling, - legal clause signed, - runbook for auto-throttle + customer notif. all green => enable exemption for pilot.

Sam (Legal): add rollback and notice language: Redwood may revoke exemption with 7 days' notice if safety signals appear. we'll draft exact verbiage and share.

Elena (Sales): customer agrees to 7d notice. they also want daily dashboards for usage vs allowance. can BillingBot create that report and drop it in the contract folder? @BillingBot

BillingBot: Acknowledged. Will create "acme-pilot-usage" daily report and share to contract folder starting tomorrow.

Priya (Finance): action: I will produce a cost-delta spreadsheet (1.5x vs baseline) and add a scenario with a fixed daily token cap by EOD Friday.

Jon (Eng): action: prototype routing flag + metadata and a monitoring runbook; aiming PR by Thu.

Maya (PM): scheduling: go/no-go next Tue 10am. if green we plan to flip exemption Thu next week.

Elena (Sales): noted, will update ACME and set expectations.

Sam (Legal): I'll circulate the clause draft tomorrow for quick review.

Maya (PM): thanks everyone. keeping this thread as the single source for pilot scope/launch criteria. :thumbsup:
